component.name: MobileNav
component.description: Horizontal sticky top navigation that appears only at <=768px. Mirrors SideNav's items and embeds the shared ThemeToggle. Scrolls horizontally if items overflow.

useCases: persistent top access to section anchors and theme toggle on mobile

commonPatterns.name: shared with SideNav
commonPatterns.description: Both components consume the same `items` array; declare once per page.

antiPatterns.scenario: rendering items not present on the page
antiPatterns.reason: Anchors target `#id` and break silently if the section is missing.
antiPatterns.alternative: Only pass ids that exist as section/element ids on the current route.

antiPatterns.reason: Sticky behaviour is the whole purpose of MobileNav.
antiPatterns.alternative: Adjust the surrounding scroll container instead.

parentConstraints: place near the top of the page body so position:sticky works

interactions.horizontalScroll: Overflow-x:auto with scrollbar hidden; touch scrolling enabled

aiHints.context: Always render alongside SideNav with identical items; never use as the sole nav on desktop.
